## 中文

### 新增

- 在“安装插件”新增“存档管理”分类，集成 Garlic SaveMgr v1.7 的主动下载、SHA-256 校验、ELF 发送和“打开存档管理页面”入口。页面使用已保存 PS5 地址的固定端口 8082；打开页面不代表服务已启动。先完成破解并启动允许电脑连接的 ELF Loader，存档修改或导入前先备份。
- 插件版本、附件大小和 SHA-256 已与 GitHub 正式发布附件元数据核对。此版本指 GitHub Release，不代表其他分支或站点的最新版本；本次不集成 Garlic Worker 在线服务。

### 修复与使用方法

- 单网卡清除后切换双网卡时，明确指出与服务网段重叠的网卡、原地址及前缀，或具体路由。原联网地址使用较大掩码时，清除新增地址不会消除原网段的重叠。
- 新增“使用建议 IP”：在候选通过当前电脑检查时提供其他私有网段。点击只填写输入框，再点击“自动配置 IP”进行配置；PS5 IP、网关、主 DNS 和软件保存的 PS5 地址仍需按更新后的提示手动调整。
- 切换模式、网卡或服务 IP 后，不再将上一次输入的错误套用到新输入。输入框标明“待添加的服务 IP”，清除结果解释保留的输入值与网卡实际地址的区别；有冲突时不显示旧网段的 PS5 参数提示。
- 保留原电脑 IP、掩码、DHCP、网关和 DNS，清除仍仅操作本工具记录的新增配置；界面预检查与配置助手共用校验逻辑，授权后再次检查实时网络。中英文界面、README 和详细指南同步更新。

### 验证与已知限制

本地 `npm ci`、87 项自动化测试和 `git diff --check` 通过。网络回归覆盖“单网卡配置 → 清除 → 双网卡冲突 → 采用建议网段 → 配置与清除 → 返回单网卡”，以及 VPN 路由、原有地址保护和授权期间网络变化。Electron 的 25 项界面模拟检查覆盖模式切换、建议地址、旧错误过滤、中英文、窄窗口布局及新增存档管理卡片和打开页面按钮；本机只读预检查确认可识别原 WLAN `/8` 与另一网卡默认服务网段的重叠。

本次没有更改系统网卡或 PS5 设置。建议通过电脑侧配置检查，不保证局域网中没有地址占用、路由器允许互访或 PS5 可达。Garlic SaveMgr 的主机服务启动、固件兼容性（包括 13.60）、存档导出／导入、恢复与重签效果尚未由本项目实机验证。macOS 实机及新增地址重启后的失效行为仍待验证。构建成功、ELF 发送完成或打开浏览器均不等于 PS5 实际执行成功。

### 发布包与免责声明

Windows x64 提供安装版和便携版；macOS Intel 与 Apple Silicon 各提供 DMG 和 ZIP，附 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。构建及发布后下载校验结果见该标签的 Actions。所有包未代码签名，macOS 未公证。

本项目仅供技术交流和合法授权测试，处理用户自行提供或有权使用的内容。应用包不附带第三方 ELF、网页资源、下载数据、密钥、证书或游戏内容；组件由用户主动下载并遵守第三方许可。软件按现状提供，不保证效果；使用者对自身操作负责，第三方权利归其所有者。完整使用边界及免责声明见 README。

## English

### Additions

- Add a Save management category with Garlic SaveMgr v1.7: user-initiated download, SHA-256 verification, ELF sending and an Open save manager action. The page uses the saved PS5 address on fixed port 8082; opening it does not confirm service startup. Jailbreak first and start a LAN-accessible ELF Loader. Back up saves before editing or importing them.
- Check the version, asset size and SHA-256 against GitHub release metadata. This version refers to the GitHub Release, not the latest version on other branches or sites. Garlic Worker online services are not integrated.

### Fixes and usage

- When switching from single- to two-adapter mode after cleanup, identify the overlapping adapter, original address and prefix, or specific route. Clearing an added address preserves original addresses; a broad original mask can still overlap with the service subnet on another adapter.
- Offer Use suggested IP when another private subnet passes current computer checks. Clicking it fills the input only; click Configure IP automatically to apply it. Manually update PS5 IP, gateway, primary DNS and the app's saved PS5 address using the revised hint.
- Do not apply a previous input's error to a newly selected mode, adapter or IP. Label the input Service IP to add, explain the difference between a retained input and actual adapter addresses after cleanup, and hide PS5 hints for a conflicting subnet.
- Preserve original computer IPs, masks, DHCP, gateways and DNS. Cleanup continues to affect only recorded app-added configuration. The interface and helper share validation, with live checks repeated after authorization. Update both interface languages, READMEs and detailed guides.

### Verification and limitations

Local `npm ci`, all 87 automated tests and `git diff --check` pass. Network regression covers single-adapter configuration, cleanup, a two-adapter overlap, adoption of a suggested subnet, configuration and cleanup, and returning to single-adapter mode. It also covers VPN routes, original-address protection and network changes during authorization. All 25 Electron checks with simulated network operations pass, covering mode switching, suggested addresses, stale-error filtering, both languages, narrow-window layout and the new save management card and open-page button. Read-only checks on this computer identify an original WLAN `/8` overlapping with the default service subnet on another adapter.

This release preparation did not change system adapters or PS5 settings. Suggestions pass computer-side configuration checks only; they do not guarantee an unused LAN address, client communication through a router or PS5 connectivity. Garlic SaveMgr service startup, firmware compatibility including 13.60, save export/import, recovery and resigning remain unverified on PS5 hardware. macOS hardware behavior and temporary-address expiration after reboot also remain unverified. Successful builds, completed ELF transfers and browser opening do not establish actual PS5 execution.

### Packages and notice

Windows x64 includes installer and portable packages. macOS Intel and Apple Silicon each include DMG and ZIP packages, with SHA256SUMS.txt. See the Actions run for this tag for builds and verification of downloaded release assets. All packages are unsigned; macOS packages are not notarized.

For technical exchange and authorized testing of user-provided or authorized content. Packages do not bundle third-party ELFs, web resources, download data, keys, certificates or game content. Component downloads require user action and remain subject to third-party licenses. The software is provided as-is without guaranteed results; users are responsible for their actions, and third-party rights remain with their owners. See the README for complete boundaries and the disclaimer.
